candidate.text: the `--cluster` behavior changed to show flows emitted from nodes outside of the provided cluster name (either coming from or going to the target cluster). This change brings consistency between the `--cluster` and `--namespace` flags and removed the incompatibility between the `--cluster` and `--node-name` flags. The previous behavior of `--cluster foo` can be reproduced with `--node-name foo/` (shows all flows emitted from a node in cluster `foo`).

evidence.excerpt:
* the `--cluster` behavior changed to show flows emitted from nodes outside of
  the provided cluster name (either coming from or going to the target cluster).
  This change brings consistency between the `--cluster` and `--namespace`
  flags and removed the incompatibility between the `--cluster` and
  `--node-name` flags. The previous behavior of `--cluster foo` can be
  reproduced with `--node-name foo/` (shows all flows emitted from a node in
  cluster `foo`).
